result:
The frontend-dev phase-01 (Setup) gate passed on attempt 1: all 3 checks passed and the verdict is **pass**.

This phase had no acceptance criteria because it's the Setup phase and belongs to no user story. So I wrote the checks from the phase review's list of what the testing loop can observe, the same way the backend phase-01 was handled. I ran them in headless Playwright:

| check | result | what I saw |
|---|---|---|
| C1: app at `http://localhost:4200` loads without the scaffold welcome page | pass | The page is blank apart from the base styles. `app-root` holds only `<router-outlet>`. |
| C2: no console errors | pass | 3 console messages, 0 errors and 0 warnings. |
| C3: `/api/app-info` through the dev server reaches the backend | pass | It returned 200 with `{"timeZone":"Africa/Cairo","now":"…+03:00"}`, which matches the API spec. |

- **Unit tests:** none are configured for the frontend layer, so the unit-test rule doesn't apply.
- **Files written:** the test plan and report are in `loops/testing/outputs/001-quickflow/frontend-dev/`. The verdict is in `loops/testing/state/001-quickflow/verdicts/frontend-dev/phase-01.json`, and the attempt folder has screenshots `shot-01..03-*.png` for each check. I also updated `current.json` and added one line to the action log in `progress.md`.
